summary: Russia launched multiple ballistic missile 'Bandel' strikes and drone attacks across Ukraine on September 6, 2026, targeting Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Odesa, Kharkiv, and Sumy regions, while US envoy Witkoff reported significant progress in Moscow negotiations. Russian strategic aviation is preparing for a massive missile strike, with Tu-95MS bombers relocating from the Far East to Engels and Olenya airfields. The Kremlin stated it will not abandon its military objectives, demanding Ukraine concede on Moscow's terms.
key_points: Two ballistic missiles 'Bandel' struck near Obukhov/Ukrainka toward Vasylkiv, and one 'Bandel' was detected in Nizhyn district of Chernihiv region heading toward Kyiv region, Brovary district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73793).
Threat of ballistic missile 'Iskander-M' launches detected from both Voronezh region and Taganrog, Rostov region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73803).
Russian forces struck two Ukrainian logistics centers in Odesa region with 'Geran-4 Sikor' drones, and struck a market in Enerdar injuring 6 people (Source: @tass_agency/394060).

Russian terrorists struck civilian logistics infrastructure in Dnipro, wounding 2 people, and struck border infrastructure in Odesa region including the ferry complex and checkpoint 'Orlivka' in Izmail district, suspending border operations (Source: @eRadarrua/111110).
US envoy Witkoff reported significant progress at Moscow negotiations on Ukrainian settlement, while the Kremlin stated it will not abandon its military objectives (Source: @tass_agency/394075).

Russian strategic aviation is preparing for a massive missile strike: Tu-95MS bombers relocating from the Far East to Engels and Olenya airfields, with 5 more armed in the Far East (Source: @eRadarrua/111094).
Active enemy tactical aviation detected on southeastern and eastern directions, posing a threat of aviation strike tools for frontline regions (Source: @kpszsu/76885).

Ukrainian Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko has been missing since Friday amid an anti-corruption investigation into protection of fraudulent call centers in his office (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33039).

sections.executive_summary: On September 6, 2026, Russia launched a multi-vector strike campaign across Ukraine using ballistic missiles 'Bandel' and various drones, hitting Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Odesa, Kharkiv, and Sumy regions simultaneously. US envoy Witkoff reported significant progress in Moscow negotiations, but the Kremlin confirmed it will not abandon its military objectives and is ready to stop the war only on its own terms. Russian strategic aviation is preparing for a massive missile strike, with Tu-95MS bombers relocating from the Far East to Engels and Olenya airfields.
ukraine: Ukrainian air defenses engaged ballistic missiles 'Bandel' near Obukhov/Ukrainka toward Vasylkiv, and detected one 'Bandel' in Nizhyn district of Chernihiv region heading toward Kyiv region, Brovary district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73793).
Air raid alert was declared in Kyiv at 02:22 on September 6, 2026, with the all-clear sounding at 02:44 (Source: @eRadarrua/111085).
Russian terrorists struck civilian logistics infrastructure in Dnipro on September 6, 2026, resulting in 2 people wounded of varying severity (Source: @eRadarrua/111110).
In Dnipro, after a series of explosions, warehouses of a logistics company caught fire (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33051).

Ukrainian Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko has been missing since Friday amid an anti-corruption investigation into protection of fraudulent call centers in his office; some journalists report he is in a private clinic in Kyiv (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33039).
Ukraine's parliament MP Kostenko promised there will be no forced mobilization of women, stating responsibility for defending the country rests with men (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33044).
Russia did not allow the American delegation to fly in, although Ukrainian airports were ready, President Zelensky stated (Source: @UkraineNow/83921).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting a multi-vector strike campaign combining ballistic missiles 'Bandel', cruise missiles, and various drones across multiple Ukrainian fronts simultaneously. The relocation of Tu-95MS strategic bombers from the Far East to Engels and Olenya airfields indicates preparation for a large-scale missile strike likely at the end of the following week. The use of ultra-low altitude flight profiles for 'Bandel' munitions significantly reduces detection and reaction time for Ukrainian air defenses, potentially shortening decision-making to mere minutes.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defense systems engaged multiple aerial threats across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Odesa, Kharkiv, and Sumy regions on September 6, 2026. The Ukrainian military has been actively requesting additional resources, as indicated by a call to close a fundraising collection. The US diplomatic delegation, including Witkoff and Kushner, traveled to Kyiv by train designated 'peace express' on the agenda, though Russia denied use of Ukrainian airports for their aircraft.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 'Bandel' munition's tactical profile—ultra-low altitude, long-range flight, high maneuverability—represents a significant evolution in Russian strike capabilities, making detection extremely difficult for Ukrainian radar systems. The simultaneous activation of tactical aviation on southeastern and eastern directions alongside ballistic and drone strikes suggests a coordinated, multi-axis operational tempo. The Kremlin's stated position that it will not abandon military objectives and Putin's readiness to stop the war only on Moscow's terms indicate a hardening negotiating posture despite reported Witkoff progress.
